29.text: The organization of the Reindeer Chukchee camp depends upon the

30.text: relations of the family-group. The Chukchee camp has a front house, the

31.text: place of which is determined by the seniority of its owner. Other houses

32.text: are located according to certain rules, based for the most part on the mutual

33.text: family relations of the owners. For all that, the organization of the camp is

34.text: unstable and loose, just as much so as that of the Chukchee family-group.²

35.text: In former times a union of “those that are together” was of a stricter

36.text: character and really formed something like a clan. A unit of this kind

37.text: included ten or fifteen families, who always camped near together. In summer,

38.text: when near the seashore, they formed usually one large camp. Some of the

39.text: young men were with the herd, which at that time was not numerous. The
